programs.title: Trapped Sisters
programs.desc: Two sisters must survive an entire night trapped beneath the fiberglass cover of a public pool. They are at the mercy of the night janitor, who sees the trapped sisters as an opportunity to solve some of her own problems.

programs.title: Murder at the Derby
programs.desc: Kara lands her dream job of working at a prestigious horse stable under the tutelage of Jennifer. However, tensions soon escalate when Jennifer's jealous brother puts everyone's lives in danger.

programs.title: Fit for Murder
programs.desc: The lives of fitness celebrities Craig Titus and Kelly Ryan take a dark turn when they hire a young female assistant.

programs.title: Dead Girl Summer
programs.desc: When Jade goes missing, Avery realizes it eerily mirrors a past tragedy involving the death of their friend, Mia. When Avery learns that Mia was murdered, she soon discovers someone is orchestrating events to make them relive that horrific summer.

programs.title: Trapped in the Spotlight
programs.desc: A psychotic music producer kidnaps a cancelled R&B singer and her former co-star 15 years after they broke up. With their lives and legacies on the line, the estranged duo must face the demons from their past to make it out alive.

programs.title: Girl Who Vanished
programs.desc: Lily and her parents are shocked when Emily, who was abducted as a child, is found and returned to the family. However, as strange events begin to unfold, they start to question whether the past is truly behind them.
